description: Connector-owned UI in the chat. Linear first: an issue card and a create-issue card in Linear's own shape, filled by the agent, edited by the person, created through Bonsai's Linear connector.

skills.description: Show a Linear issue, or draft and create one, through Linear-shaped cards in the chat instead of prose. Use for 'show NEAT-9', 'what's the status of', 'create an issue for', 'file this in Linear'. Reads go through linear://, the create goes through the Linear MCP after the person presses Create issue on the card.

tools.description: Show one Linear issue in the chat as a card in Linear's own issue layout. Read the issue from linear:// first, then pass its fields.
Draft a new Linear issue in the chat as Linear's create dialog, prefilled. The person edits and presses Create issue; the card sends the final values back as a message.
Show one or more Linear issues in the chat. Bonsai's Jev picks the view (one issue, a list, or a board by status) and the fields from the task.
